taskSpec.projectGoal: To develop a lightweight, standalone HRMS application that can be run directly from a browser using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript without any backend dependencies.

included: Employee data management (add, view, edit, delete employees)
Attendance tracking with date and status
Basic reporting dashboard showing employee statistics
Responsive design that works on desktop and mobile devices
Local storage for data persistence
Single HTML file implementation
excluded: User authentication and role-based access control
Advanced analytics or complex reporting features

constraints: Single HTML file implementation without external dependencies
Use of only browser-native technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
Responsive design for various screen sizes
No backend server or database required
risks: Limited data persistence capabilities with localStorage
Performance issues with large datasets in a single HTML file
Browser compatibility concerns with older browsers
Security risks associated with client-side data storage
Scalability limitations for enterprise-level HR operations
